text:
Incident Bot: Auto-summary for thread: Sev2 at 12:12 UTC impacting hosted inference in us-west-2. Symptoms: request latency >2s and intermittent 502s for a subset of tenants. Mitigation: rolled back model to v1.2 at 12:45 UTC. Customer impact reported for 3 paying customers. Please schedule a post-incident review within 1 week and assign a facilitator + scribe.

Aisha (SRE): I can facilitate, happy to run the timeline and RCA format. Prefer Thu or Fri this week. Would like the model and infra leads there.

Tom (oncall): Thu afternoon works for me, Wed morning is a hard no (standup). Also can provide the on-call timeline notes.

Priya (Product): Please include the impacted customer PMs and support lead so we can confirm impact messaging. I can invite Amy from key-cust if we pick a time.

Morgan (Eng): Can the model team provide perf/regression diffs? I'll pull the quantization/compile logs. If Thu, aim for 15:00-16:00 UTC so east coast can join.

Kei (DevEx): I'll take scribe if nobody else volunteers. I can capture meeting notes in the postmortem doc and add action item template.

Claire (Ops): Add a check for cost regression in the agenda (we saw token cost spike). Also include tracing screenshots and upstream infra alerts.

Jared (SRE): Quick note — we should lock the postmortem doc to the incident owner to avoid diverging edits until the meeting. I'll add the initial timeline draft later today.

Aisha (SRE): Proposed slots (please react with :one: :two: :three: or reply with availability)
1) Thu 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC
2) Thu 2026-03-12 17:00 UTC
3) Fri 2026-03-13 14:00 UTC

Tom (oncall): :one: works for me.

Priya (Product): :one: + I'll invite customer PMs (Amy).

Morgan (Eng): :one: preferred.

Kei (DevEx): :one: I'll block calendar and create notes doc.

Claire (Ops): :one: good.

Jared (SRE): :one: confirmed.

Incident Bot: Calendar invite created for Thu 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC. Link to draft postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortems/INC-1769001123>. Meeting pinned to thread.

Aisha (SRE): Facilitator: Aisha (confirmed). Scribe: Kei (confirmed). Please add these to the invite. Attendees (so far): Aisha, Kei, Tom, Priya, Morgan, Claire, Jared, plus customer reps (Amy). If anyone else should be on the attendee list, say now.

Priya (Product): Requesting product-sent summary of customer-visible impact and any escalations prior to meeting. I'll paste the support thread in the doc.

Morgan (Eng): Prework for model team: attach perf diffs (before/after), quantization matrices, and compile logs. We'll add a TL;DR in the doc.

Claire (Ops): Ops prework: alert graphs, cost/time-of-day overlays, and the infra incident timeline.

Jared (SRE): I'll fill in on-call timeline and mitigation commands run. Also will add the exact rollback command used.

Aisha (SRE): Action items to capture before meeting (owners + due):
- model perf diffs (Morgan) — due Wed EOD
- on-call timeline + commands (Jared) — due Wed EOD
- customer impact summary (Priya) — due Wed EOD
- cost/regression graphs (Claire) — due Wed EOD
- notes doc + invite (Kei) — done (I'll paste link in doc)

Kei (DevEx): Done — notes doc created and locked for editing: <https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortems/INC-1769001123/edit>. I'll open edit access to attendees after authorship pins.

Tom (oncall): Small ask — can we add the Canary logs and the routing policy that kicked in? Will upload by Wed morning.

Priya (Product): For customer comms, I'd like to draft a short follow-up email after the postmortem. Will coordinate with Support to get exact impacted request IDs.

Aisha (SRE): Meeting agenda (short): 1) timeline 2) root cause hypotheses 3) evidence 4) mitigations + rollback rationale 5) action items + owners 6) customer comms plan. Please keep prework in the doc.

Claire (Ops): One more ask — tag cost-impact in the action items so finance is looped if it looks high. I'll ping finance after meeting if needed.

Priya (Product): Can someone add the impacted tenant list to the doc? Support has it, I'll paste after I get permission.

Jared (SRE): Will add the impacted tenant IDs and the exact error rates measured.

Incident Bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before meeting and 1h before meeting.

Aisha (SRE): Great — final confirmation: Thu 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC, Facilitator Aisha, Scribe Kei, attendees Aisha, Kei, Tom, Priya, Morgan, Claire, Jared, customer PM Amy (optional). Prework due Wed EOD. If no objections, I'll move the postmortem to final and assign owners after the prework items land.

Morgan (Eng): No objections. See you Thu.

Kei (DevEx): I'll add action-item checkboxes to the doc and a follow-up reminder for owners on Thu morning.

Priya (Product): Thanks all. I'll add the customer note in the doc now.

Jared (SRE): Uploaded timeline draft to doc.

Incident Bot: Thread closed for scheduling. Use the postmortem doc for updates.
